summary: Consolidated Edison, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register the offer and sale of up to $2,000,000,000 of its common shares through an equity distribution agreement with multiple sales agents and forward purchasers. This is a routine at-the-market (ATM) equity shelf takedown, allowing the company to sell shares over time at prevailing market prices. The filing includes provisions for forward sale agreements, but no immediate transaction is announced; the facility is established for future capital-raising. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special-situation event. The filing is a standard securities registration for ordinary capital management under Rule 415.
